decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (Site location plan; 722BATH/EXI/GND/100MAY12; 722BATH/EXI/SIDEELEVS/100MAY12; 722BATH/EXI/REARELEV/100MAY12; 722BATH/PROP/GND/100MAY12; 722BATH/PROP/ELEVS/100MAY12; 722BATH/PROP/SIDEELEVS/100MAY12; 722BATH/PROP/REARELEVS/100MAY12; 722BATH/PROP/SIDEELEVS/100MAY12; 722BATH/LOC/250/MAY12 (received 11/06/2012); Acoustic report by Alpha Acoustics ref AA459/13/08/12 dated 15/08/2012 (received 23/08/2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 09:00am to 11:00pm.

Condition : 4 - Development to be completed in accordance with the recommendations of the acoustic report by Alpha Acoustics ref AA459/13/08/12 dated 15/08/2012 prior to the first beneficial occupation of the use hereby approved. The installed acoustic insulation shall thereafter be maintained as such.
